name: FPP Preprocessed Audio Sync (Prototype)
author: Community hobbyist prototype
description: Uploads FPP music files and playback timing to a separately hosted listener backend. Experimental.

privacy.summary: Sends show music and playback timing to your chosen HTTPS server so visitors can listen on their phones.

sends.to: the backend HTTPS server you configure
sends.what: music files, show playback position, and player device ID
sends.why: to stream show audio to visitors

systemChanges.what: Installs a systemd service that monitors FPP playback and sends updates.

privacy.other: The backend is separately deployed and serves audio to phones; review music streaming rights and backend access controls.
